source.name: Football Australia: 'Nike and Football Australia unveil the 2026 National Team Collection, a celebration of two decades on the world stage'
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. No commercial sponsor on any placement: the launch photos on this page (Hrustic and Bos wearing the shirt front, crest and shorts detail) show a plain yellow front and plain gradient-green shorts, and Footy Headlines' launch article (23 March 2026, footyheadlines.com/2026/01/australia-2026-home-kit.html) shows the official flat and worn retail images - front, back, sleeves and hem - with only the Nike swoosh and the Australia crest and nothing else.
source.quote: Nike and Football Australia today unveil the 2026 National Team Collection, setting a new benchmark in national team kit design.

summary: The 2026 home shirt carries no commercial sponsor logos - front, back, sleeves and shorts were checked on the Football Australia launch photos and on Footy Headlines' official flat and worn images from the 23 March 2026 release; only the Australia crest and the Nike maker mark appear. Nike is the kit maker.
headline: The shirt is {level}: it carries no commercial sponsors. Nike makes the kit.
